limitations: Open Targets data version is a CURRENT snapshot (26.09). It therefore includes evidence published after the EviRep 2021-01-01 cutoff. Unlike the clinical dimension (script 03), this dimension is NOT cutoff-bounded. Residual temporal optimism is possible even though the two label-encoding datatypes are excluded. See development_log/ERRORS_AND_BLOCKERS.md B-001.
The direct component re-aggregates allowed datatype scores with max(), which is NOT Open Targets' official harmonic-sum weighting; the official per-datatype weights are not exposed by the API.
Pathway membership is Reactome-only (as exposed by Open Targets Target.pathways). KEGG/WikiPathways are not consulted, so pathway coverage is incomplete for genes poorly annotated in Reactome.
Shared pathway membership is co-membership, not a directional mechanistic claim: it does not establish that the drug modulates the disease process.

Pathway overlap is unweighted by pathway size or specificity. A match in a broad Reactome pathway counts the same as a match in a narrow one, so the pathway component can be driven by generic signalling/metabolic pathways. Specificity weighting is recorded as future work in TECHNICAL_DEBT.md TD-007.
